svg.text: fome-mc — 4-Layer Integrated Motorcycle ECU Floorplan & Functional Zones
Board Dimensions: 162.0 mm × 115.0 mm (Edge.Cuts X=26..188, Y=25..140 • 4× M4 Holes H1..H4) • 510 Schematic Components (494 Populated + 16 DNP + 4× M4 = 514 Footprints) • Dual 35-Pin TE AMPSEAL
Power, Grounds, INJ1..4 (42V Clamp), IGBT1..4, AUX_LS1..4, MAIN_RLY, ETB1/2, STEP, WBO HTR (>=1.5mm), DFU
CLT, IAT, TPS1/2, MAP1, Ext Baro (J2-6), Gear, Knock, VR1/2 (Mode A2), Hall, WBO1/2, CAN1, USB
POWER SUPPLY, KEEP-ALIVE, LDOs, CAN, IGN & LOW/HIGH-SIDE DRIVERS
STM32H753 BRAIN, PRECISION REF, VR (MODE A2) & ANALOG FRONT-END
4-Layer Impedance-Controlled Stackup (1.6 mm FR-4 TG170, 1 oz Outer / 1 oz Inner) & Thermal Coupling
• L1 (F.Cu): High-speed signals, 90Ω USB / 120Ω CAN diff pairs, SDMMC1 (4GB SDNAND), SPI4 (WINC1500 Wi-Fi), WBO1/2_H- (>=1.50mm, <0.05Ω), HV_IGN (0.50mm clearance / 1.2mm)
• L2 (In1.Cu): Unbroken solid GND plane + Star AGND split • L3 (In2.Cu): +5V, +3.3V, +12V_MR, +12V_RAW, +3V3_WBO1/2 power islands • L4 (B.Cu): Bottom GND + thermal pad coupling
